newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks slip on profit-taking in London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks slip on profit-taking in London.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks slipped on profit-taking in London, dealers said.
In otherwise featureless trading, dealers noted light profit-taking, mainly in property stocks, which have advanced sharply recently.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was off 8.28 points at 13,446.65 at 1353 GMT.
Shares in Cheung Kong were trading at HK$74.5 at 1353 GMT, down from a close in Hong Kong at HK$74.75.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Index rose 34.77 to 13,454.93, led by gains in Cheung Kong shares.
"Property shares have been running away and there's some concern that the Hong Kong government will step in and do something about it," said one London broker.
"We're seeing a bit of profit-taking, but overall there's very little trade going on," he added.
